message.content: {"hts_code": "8424.90.9000", "reason": "A decorative garden arbor of tubular steel for residential use is a structural garden article not elsewhere classified, falling under parts of garden or lawn equipment in heading 8424 (mechanical appliances for projecting or dispersing liquids or powders) and, more appropriately, under HTS heading 7308 for structures of iron or steel; the best fit is 7308.90.9590 for other structures of iron or steel, but since this 10-digit code cannot be confirmed without the official HTSUS schedule, a broader classification under 7308.90 for other iron or steel structures is applicable."}

predicted_reason: A decorative garden arbor of tubular steel for residential use is a structural garden article not elsewhere classified, falling under parts of garden or lawn equipment in heading 8424 (mechanical appliances for projecting or dispersing liquids or powders) and, more appropriately, under HTS heading 7308 for structures of iron or steel; the best fit is 7308.90.9590 for other structures of iron or steel, but since this 10-digit code cannot be confirmed without the official HTSUS schedule, a broader classification under 7308.90 for other iron or steel structures is applicable.
